title: Rum & Broadsides: a free Caribbean RPG where you trade rum, board ships and make your fortune
author: vlookup_enjoyer
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’m the creator of **Rum & Broadsides**, a free pixel-art browser game set in the Caribbean in 1715.

You arrive in Port Royal with £100 and a borrowed sword. Someone promptly steals your purse. It’s a promising start.

From there, you can trade between islands, join the Royal Navy and climb the ranks, hunt for treasure, or build an estate producing sugar and rum.

Naval combat involves lining up broadsides and getting close enough to board enemy ships and duel their captains. Back ashore, there are tavern fights, fencing lessons, quests and increasingly expensive ways to spend your money.

Eventually, you can retire to England with your fortune and pass bonuses on to your next character.

**Play free in your browser:** [Rum & Broadsides on CrazyGames](https://www.crazygames.com/game/rum-broadsides)

I’d love some feedback on the first few minutes: is it clear what to do, and does it get you into the fun quickly enough? If something makes you stop playing, knowing where would really help.
